strings.en: Embrace despair and fear, and die...
Let fear be carved into your heart...
Your despair shall be our sustenance...
To the end of endless suffering...
Even our deaths shall feed us...

strings.jp: 「ここで我らを打ち倒したところで……」
strings.en: Even if you defeat us here...
In time, ruin will come for you too...

strings.jp: 「我らの代わりはいくらでも……」
strings.en: There are countless more to replace us...

strings.jp: 「何という……正と負が入り混じった波動……」
strings.en: Such waves... positive and negative,/　intertwined...
At this rate... the vessel won't hold...!
This vessel... cannot contain it all...!

strings.jp: 「何故、破滅の宿命を受け入れぬのだ……？」
strings.en: Why won't you accept/　your destined ruin...?
Accept it... the time of ruin is near...
Why... why won't you abandon hope...?

strings.jp: 「飽くなき生への執着……それが……」
strings.en: This insatiable clinging to life.../　That is what...

strings.jp: 「宿命を変える気か……その力で……」
strings.en: You mean to change fate.../　with that power...?
That power.../　will be the finest sustenance...
That will... we have received it...

strings.jp: 「どうあがこうと……結果は同じ……」
strings.en: However you struggle.../　the result is the same...

strings.jp: 「全てが“破滅の王”の糧となる……」
strings.en: All shall feed the King of Ruin...

strings.jp: 「もうお前達の運命は変わらぬと言うのに……」
strings.en: Your fate is already sealed, and yet...

strings.jp: 「あくまで希望を持ち続けるか……」
strings.en: So you cling to hope to the very end...
Even that Mettle shall feed us...

strings.jp: 「我らを止めることは出来ぬ……」
「お前の憎しみは、その程度か……？」
strings.en: Is that all your hatred amounts to...?

strings.jp: 「その憎悪、闘志……我らが受け止めよう」
strings.en: That hatred, that Mettle.../　We shall receive it all.
You cannot defeat us, the Ruina...
Writhe in agony, and raise your curses...
